support.authority: closed Game 2 attacker-only Stage A registry
support.position_smoothing: centered seven-frame mean requiring complete observed support
support.velocity: consecutive smoothed-position difference divided by observed time difference
support.boundaries: period, frozen Stage A support segment, BALL OUT, and SET PIECE

classification.SUPPORTED: valid; all three numerical gates and objective audit checks pass; no scientific rule changed
classification.MIXED: valid; fragmentation reduction is at least 20%, but a safety, coverage, or objective audit requirement fails without implementation invalidity
classification.NOT_SUPPORTED: valid; fragmentation improves by less than 20%, does not improve, or merging/direction exceeds 3.97%
classification.INVALID: support, implementation, governance, or construct validity failure only

visual_audit.chronological_rule: equally spaced quantiles of sorted frozen valid-support-segment midpoints; six-second support-complete display where available
visual_audit.direct_rule: first chronological support-complete four-second own-trajectory window with path >=3 m and Q >=0.95
visual_audit.direction_rule: first chronological support-complete four-second own-trajectory window with path >=3 m and reliable cumulative turning >=90 degrees
visual_audit.low_speed_rule: first chronological support-complete four-second own-trajectory window with peak speed <2 m/s and path >=1 m
visual_audit.discontinuity_rule: first chronological frozen Stage A invalid interval with adjacent valid support
